app.name: Photo slideshow
app.summary: Your own photos large on the screen, a new one every few minutes; tap for the next.
app.fit_hint: Cover fills the tile and cuts away what is over; contain shows the whole photo.
app.caption: Album and numbers
app.caption_hint: The album and which photo of how many, such as Holiday · 12/148.
app.interval_hint: 0: Home Assistant sets the pace (its slideshow interval). Otherwise this screen asks for the next photo after so many seconds, at least 5; with several screens on one sensor, every screen gets the new photo.
app.saver_example: The album and which photo of how many, over the photo
app.corner_hint: Where the caption stands on the glass.
app.saver_title_hint: Words of your own, such as Holiday 2026. Leave it empty for the name of the album or folder.
app.numbers_hint: Which photo of how many, such as 12/148.
app.photo_name_hint: The photo's own name: its file name, or its original name in Immich.
app.place_hint: Where the photo was taken, such as Granada, Spain. From Immich; photos without a place show none.
app.photo_date_hint: The day the photo was taken. From Immich.
app.clock_hint: The time of day above the details.
app.saver_own_example: The slideshow’s photo with its place, name and the time
app.transition_hint: How the next photo comes: the old one slides away to the left or to the right, or the new one is there at once.
app.time_corner_hint: With the details, above them, or in a corner of its own.
